markerRaw.description: PART 12 §13 F1: the marker that opened the node, as authored, separator excluded.

markerColumn.description: PART 12 §13 F2: zero-based visual column of the marker, in PART 9 §24 C1 arithmetic - not pos.startColumn, which is 1-based.

contentColumn.description: PART 12 §13 F3: content_column(node) per PART 9 §24 C3, same zero-based arithmetic as markerColumn.

continuationStyle.description: PART 12 §13 F4: how the node's later lines reached it, one value by precedence explicit > lazy > indent > marker_line > none.

blankLinesBefore.description: PART 12 §13 F5: authored count of whitespace-only lines immediately before the node, within its container.

blankLinesAfter.description: PART 12 §13 F5: authored count of whitespace-only lines immediately after the node, within its container.

openerRaw.description: PART 12 §13 F6: the opening delimiter run as authored, info string excluded. Never empty.

closerRaw.description: PART 12 §13 F6: the closing delimiter run as authored, EMPTY where the block was unterminated. Absent means unmeasured, as for every other fact.

metadataSeparatorRaw.description: PART 12 §13 F7: the separator run between a label or term and its body, whitespace included.

leadingPipe.description: PART 12 §13 F8: whether the row was authored with the optional leading pipe.

trailingPipe.description: PART 12 §13 F8: whether the row was authored with the optional trailing pipe.

attachment.description: PART 12 §13 F9: how the node reached its host. detached records an attachable position the spelling separated (PART 9 §4).
